title: merge 与 rebase 的历史拓扑差异（含分歧度统计）
expected_output:
=== 原始分叉 ===
  main    : 2ea4292(chore: init) -> 78abb09(feat: base api) -> 7e2fdda(fix: hotfix A) -> e744634(chore: bump version)
  feature : 2ea4292(chore: init) -> 78abb09(feat: base api) -> 6c06137(feat: cart part1) -> c003ed1(feat: cart part2)
  ahead/behind(feature vs main) = (2, 2)；分歧度 = 4

=== 策略 A: git merge --no-ff feature ===
  main 第一亲代链: 2ea4292(chore: init) -> 78abb09(feat: base api) -> 7e2fdda(fix: hotfix A) -> e744634(chore: bump version) -> 7e89dd2(Merge branch 'feature' into main)
  是否产生 merge commit: True（parent 数 = 2）
  可达提交数: 7
  历史线性: False
  原 feature 提交是否未被改写（仍在 main 祖先集合里）: True

=== 策略 B: git rebase main feature ===
  被重放的提交: ['feat: cart part1', 'feat: cart part2']
  feature 第一亲代链: 2ea4292(chore: init) -> 78abb09(feat: base api) -> 7e2fdda(fix: hotfix A) -> e744634(chore: bump version) -> 36092ab(feat: cart part1) -> bd2bc90(feat: cart part2)
  可达提交数: 6
  历史线性: True
  旧提交是否已被取代（不再可达）: True
  main 能否快进到 feature: True

取舍: merge 不改写历史、保留并行开发真相；rebase 线性可读但改写 SHA，勿用于已共享提交
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""同一份分叉历史，分别施加 merge --no-ff 与 rebase，对比 resulting 拓扑 / 提交数 / 线性度。"""
import zlib


def short(tag):
    return "%07x" % (zlib.crc32(tag.encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFF)


class Repo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.parents, self.msg, self.refs = {}, {}, {}

    def commit(self, msg, parents=()):
        cid = short(msg + "#" + ",".join(parents))
        self.parents[cid] = list(parents)
        self.msg[cid] = msg
        return cid

    def ancestors(self, start):
        seen, stack = set(), [start]
        while stack:
            n = stack.pop()
            if n in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(n)
            stack.extend(self.parents.get(n, []))
        return seen

    def ahead_behind(self, a, b):
        anc_a, anc_b = self.ancestors(a), self.ancestors(b)
        return len(anc_a - anc_b), len(anc_b - anc_a)

    def first_parent_chain(self, head):
        chain, cur = [], head
        while cur:
            chain.append("%s(%s)" % (cur, self.msg[cur]))
            cur = (self.parents.get(cur) or [None])[0]
        return " -> ".join(reversed(chain))



def build():
    r = Repo()
    m0 = r.commit("chore: init")
    m1 = r.commit("feat: base api", [m0])
    f1 = r.commit("feat: cart part1", [m1])
    f2 = r.commit("feat: cart part2", [f1])
    m2 = r.commit("fix: hotfix A", [m1])
    m3 = r.commit("chore: bump version", [m2])
    r.refs["main"], r.refs["feature"] = m3, f2
    return r, (f1, f2)


base, extracted = build()
ahead, behind = base.ahead_behind(base.refs["feature"], base.refs["main"])
print("=== 原始分叉 ===")
print("  main    : " + base.first_parent_chain(base.refs["main"]))
print("  feature : " + base.first_parent_chain(base.refs["feature"]))
print("  ahead/behind(feature vs main) = (%d, %d)；分歧度 = %d" % (ahead, behind, ahead + behind))
print()

# ---- 策略 A: merge --no-ff ----
rA, (f1, f2) = build()
merge_commit = rA.commit("Merge branch 'feature' into main", [rA.refs["main"], rA.refs["feature"]])
rA.refs["main"] = merge_commit
print("=== 策略 A: git merge --no-ff feature ===")
print("  main 第一亲代链: " + rA.first_parent_chain(rA.refs["main"]))
print("  是否产生 merge commit: %s（parent 数 = %d）"
      % (len(rA.parents[merge_commit]) == 2, len(rA.parents[merge_commit])))
print("  可达提交数: %d" % len(rA.ancestors(rA.refs["main"])))
print("  历史线性: %s" % all(len(v) <= 1 for v in rA.parents.values()))
print("  原 feature 提交是否未被改写（仍在 main 祖先集合里）: %s" % (f2 in rA.ancestors(rA.refs["main"])))
print()

# ---- 策略 B: rebase ----
rB, _ = build()
ahead, _behind = rB.ahead_behind(rB.refs["feature"], rB.refs["main"])
tip = rB.refs["main"]
replayed = []
queue = [rB.refs["feature"]]
seen = set()
while queue:
    n = queue.pop(0)
    if n in seen or n in rB.ancestors(rB.refs["main"]):
        continue
    seen.add(n)
    replayed.append(n)
    queue.extend(rB.parents.get(n, []))
replayed.sort(key=lambda c: len(rB.ancestors(c)))
for c in replayed:
    tip = rB.commit(rB.msg[c], [tip])
rB.refs["feature"] = tip
old_map = {c: rB.msg[c] for c in replayed}
print("=== 策略 B: git rebase main feature ===")
print("  被重放的提交: %s" % [rB.msg[c] for c in replayed])
print("  feature 第一亲代链: " + rB.first_parent_chain(rB.refs["feature"]))
print("  可达提交数: %d" % len(rB.ancestors(rB.refs["feature"])))
print("  历史线性: %s" % all(len(v) <= 1 for v in rB.parents.values()))
print("  旧提交是否已被取代（不再可达）: %s" % all(c not in rB.ancestors(tip) for c in old_map))
print("  main 能否快进到 feature: %s" % (rB.refs["main"] in rB.ancestors(rB.refs["feature"])))
print()
print("取舍: merge 不改写历史、保留并行开发真相；rebase 线性可读但改写 SHA，勿用于已共享提交")
